concepts.gloss_en: "We will do and we will hear" — Israel's acceptance of Torah at Sinai (Exod. 24:7)

reason_for_human: All four occurrences are the identical fixed phrase na'aseh v'nishma, the Sinai acceptance formula quoted from Shabbat 88a. The only vocalization difference (נִשְׁמַע vs נִשְׁמָע) is pausal variation of the same word, not a homograph. Single concept across LM 22 and 65.
